assets.title: Cardiometabolic monitoring
assets.description: A longitudinal primary-care cohort with encounters, diagnoses, vital signs, laboratory reports, and medication requests.
assets.purpose: Demonstrate clinically plausible longitudinal FHIR search, analytics, and blood-pressure workflows.
learning_objectives: Search observations by patient, code, category, and date
Inspect systolic and diastolic components in a FHIR blood-pressure panel
Compare FHIR search parameters with the generated MongoDB query
assets.disclaimer: Curated demonstration data, not an epidemiological model or a source of clinical evidence.

assets.title: Oncology care pathway
assets.description: A diagnosis-to-treatment cohort containing conditions, pathology-oriented reports, specimens, procedures, care plans, and medication activity.
assets.purpose: Demonstrate a connected multi-resource cancer pathway and longitudinal document/search workflows.
learning_objectives: Follow references across diagnosis, diagnostic work-up, and treatment resources
Search a patient's oncology timeline through standard FHIR endpoints
Inspect how connected FHIR documents remain independently queryable in MongoDB
assets.disclaimer: Curated demonstration data, not a clinical protocol, treatment recommendation, or epidemiological model.

assets.title: Payer and claims journey
assets.description: A member-centred insurance cohort with eligibility, coverage, encounters, claims, adjudication responses, and explanations of benefit.
assets.purpose: Demonstrate payer interoperability, claims search, and operational analytics over connected FHIR resources.
learning_objectives: Trace eligibility, coverage, claim, response, and explanation-of-benefit references
Compare FHIR financial-resource searches with native MongoDB analytics
Inspect a member timeline without relying on a closed managed FHIR service
assets.disclaimer: Curated demonstration data, not an actuarial model, reimbursement schedule, or regulatory test corpus.
